title: Locate and Identify the 'Tech Spec' Icon Component
description: Find the React component rendering the 'Tech Spec' UI element and determine the current icon used from the lucide-react library.
details: Perform a project-wide text search for the string 'Tech Spec' to locate the relevant component, likely in app/page.tsx or a shared component in components/. Identify the icon component (e.g., <FileText />) currently used alongside the 'Tech Spec' label. Confirm if the icon is used in multiple places or just this instance.
test_strategy: Verify that the correct component and icon are identified by cross-referencing the UI and code. No code changes are made in this step.

title: Select a New Semantically Appropriate Icon from lucide-react
description: Choose a new icon from the lucide-react library that better represents the 'Tech Spec' label.
details: Browse the lucide.dev website or the lucide-react documentation to find an icon that is semantically aligned with 'Tech Spec' (e.g., <BookOpen />, <ListChecks />, etc.). Ensure the icon is visually compatible with the existing design and accessible as a decorative element.
test_strategy: Confirm the selected icon is available in lucide-react and is appropriate for the context. No code changes are made in this step.

title: Update the Component to Use the New Icon
description: Replace the old icon with the new one in the identified component, ensuring all styling and accessibility properties are preserved.
details: Update the import statement to bring in the new icon from lucide-react. In the JSX, replace the old icon component with the new one, ensuring the className (e.g., 'h-4 w-4') and any aria attributes are preserved. If the icon appears in multiple places, update only the specified instance unless otherwise required.
test_strategy: Run the development server and visually inspect the UI to ensure the new icon appears correctly, maintains alignment, and inherits the correct styles. Check for accessibility using browser dev tools.

title: Perform Visual and Accessibility Verification
description: Visually verify the icon replacement in the running application and check for accessibility compliance.
details: Start the development server (npm run dev) and navigate to the page where the 'Tech Spec' UI element appears. Confirm the new icon renders correctly, is visually aligned, and maintains the intended styling. Use browser accessibility tools to ensure the icon is decorative (aria-hidden) and does not interfere with screen readers.
test_strategy: Manual visual inspection in multiple browsers and devices. Use browser accessibility audit tools (e.g., Lighthouse, axe) to confirm compliance.
